# BibleSpeak.org

> The most comprehensive Bible word pronunciation resource on the web — 858 words with audio, phonetic spelling, and biblical context.

BibleSpeak.org helps pastors, Bible teachers, seminary students, Sunday school leaders, and anyone who studies or preaches Scripture pronounce biblical words correctly. Every entry includes an audio recording, a phonetic spelling breakdown, the word's biblical meaning, and historical context — completely free.

The site is a proud partner of GraceOnlineLibrary.org, a trusted Bible study resource with over 25 years serving Christians online. Pronunciations follow established scholarly and traditional conventions used in seminaries and Bible colleges.

## About

- [About BibleSpeak.org](https://biblespeak.org/about/): Mission, coverage, background, and who uses the site
- [Contact](https://biblespeak.org/contact/): hello@biblespeak.org — word suggestions, corrections, and general questions welcome

## Coverage

858 biblical words, names, and places across both Testaments, including:
- Personal names: patriarchs, kings, prophets, apostles, and named figures
- Places and geography: cities, regions, mountains, rivers, and nations
- Hebrew and Greek terms: theological words, titles, and transliterated terms
- Historical context and meaning for each entry

## Word Pages

Individual word pages follow the pattern: `https://biblespeak.org/[word-slug]-pronunciation/`

Each page includes:
- Phonetic pronunciation (e.g., "zeh-RUB-uh-bel")
- Audio recording (MP3)
- Biblical meaning
- Historical and scriptural context
- Related words from the same letter

Notable examples:
- [Zerubbabel](https://biblespeak.org/zerubbabel-pronunciation/)
- [Mephibosheth](https://biblespeak.org/mephibosheth-pronunciation/)
- [Jehoshaphat](https://biblespeak.org/jehoshaphat-pronunciation/)
- [Theophilus](https://biblespeak.org/theophilus-pronunciation/)
- [Methuselah](https://biblespeak.org/methuselah-pronunciation/)

A full index of all 858 words is available at: https://biblespeak.org/sitemap.xml
